status: DQN sample efficiency study complete — 50-100 episodes optimal, HMM benefits more from training than MA
key_finding: More episodes does not consistently improve DQN walk-forward performance. 50 episodes is the TSLA sweet spot (both MA and HMM beat B&H 3/3). HMM at 200 episodes shows +6.2pp spread vs MA at -8.7pp — HMM generalizes better with more training. NVDA, SPY, AAPL never beat B&H regardless of episode count.
